idea-plugin.name: Nylo
idea-plugin.description:
Nylo for Android Studio

Utilities for Nylo Flutter projects. Auto-detects .env* environment files and generates matching Flutter run configurations and Metro make:env external tools — so you can switch between Dev, Prod, Staging, and any other environment with one click.

Features

  • Auto-syncs run configurations on project open and live as you add or remove .env* files.
  • Manual Tools → Sync Nylo Environments action.
  • Removes the run configuration and Metro External Tool when an .env* file is deleted.
  • Title-cased display names (.env.prod.staging → Prod Staging).
  • Nylo Logs tool window: browse the app's logs/ with date, session and text filters.
  • Nylo Screenshots tool window: capture App Store / Play Store screenshots of any page across multiple locales and devices, driven by Nylo's built-in screenshot mode.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0

  • Live .env* sync: run configurations and Metro External Tools are now created and removed automatically as you add or delete .env* files — no restart or manual sync needed. Deleting an .env* file also removes its Metro External Tool.

0.2.0

  • Nylo Screenshots: a new left-stripe tool window that lists your pages (parsed from router.dart), locales (lang/) and running devices, then captures device-resolution screenshots of each page/locale via Nylo screenshot mode.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: .env* auto-detection and Flutter run config / Metro External Tools generation.
